description: Schema exports whose rows belong to one business. Feature code may not import these (or anything in alsoGuarded) from @/db/schema; it goes through forBusiness() in src/db/scope.ts. eslint.config.mjs reads this file, and src/db/tenancy.test.ts fails if a table with a business_id column is missing from "tables".

alsoGuarded.businesses: The business row itself. Read and change it through scope.business() and scope.updateBusiness().
alsoGuarded.membershipLocations: Has no business_id; its rows belong to a membership, so it is guarded with memberships.

platformFilesReason: These create businesses, decide who is acting in one, resolve plans and write the activity log. They run before a scope exists, or for every business, so they import business tables directly. Keep this list short.
